newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Santa Fe Pacific Gold cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Santa Fe Pacific Gold cut.

text.p: -- JP Morgan said analyst David Neuhaus downgraded Santa Fe Pacific Gold Corp to market perform from buy.

-- cited latest offer from Homestake Mining Co to buy Santa Fe for about $16.45 per share, and the unlikelihood that Newmont Mining Corp, which also bid for Newmont, would raise its offer. Newmont offered to swap 0.33 of its shares for each Santa Fe share.
-- Santa Fe was unchanged at 16-1/2, Newmont was off 1/8 to 46-7/8, and Homestake added 1/8 to 14-7/8.
